title: bonsai.help/1
description: bonsai --help --json (plan-5 5.1.10; Rohan, 9 Oct: Bonsai is managed by agents inside projects): the whole tool as one document, so an agent learns it without reading a page. Every command word with its flags, its exit codes and its examples; the exit codes every word shares; and every known word of the error object's code with its meaning and who usually takes the next step. It is read from the same tables that make the human --help and the behaviour (the word registry in cmd/bonsai, format.ExitCodes, format.ErrorWords), so it cannot drift from them; a test holds it to every word, flag and error word the tables have. Printed, never stored. bonsai --help --json prints every word; a word's own --help stays text. Written by bonsai; read by agents, CI and the studio. A writer writes every field below, in this order, null, [] or {} where it does not apply (contract section 2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null, keeps an unknown one and refuses a duplicate key.
